name: malayalam-fail-sounds
description: Plays a random Malayalam sound clip whenever a terminal command exits with a non-zero code.

malayalamFailSounds.soundsFolder.description: Optional absolute path to a folder of your own .mp3/.wav clips. If empty, uses the bundled sounds/malayalam folder.

malayalamFailSounds.cooldownMs.description: Minimum milliseconds between two sound triggers, to avoid spamming on repeated fast failures.

enumDescriptions: Use the system audio player if one is available, otherwise fall back to the built-in webview player.
Only use the system audio player (afplay / PowerShell / ffplay etc.).
Only use the built-in webview player. Requires clicking 'Enable fail sounds' once per session.
malayalamFailSounds.playbackMode.description: How sounds are played. 'auto' is recommended: it needs no interaction, while the webview player is subject to the browser autoplay policy.

malayalamFailSounds.ignoredExitCodes.description: Exit codes that should never trigger a sound. 130 is Ctrl+C, which is not really a failure.

malayalamFailSounds.ignoredCommands.description: Regular expressions matched against the command line. A match means no sound, even on a non-zero exit. Defaults cover commands that use exit code 1 to mean 'no matches' rather than 'failed'.

commands.title: Malayalam Fail Sounds: Play a Random Test Sound
